Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then to docs, then to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter for target CHEMBL6136 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
